svg.title: S3 — Command forwarded to the owner replica, then propagated by event (US109; same for US106a, US208)

g.text: S3 — Command forwarded to the owner replica, then propagated by event (US109; same for US106a, US208)
unicast, one peer at a time;
Single owner: one copy of each airport in a write model, one producer of its events (ordered per airport).
Owner answers 4xx (e.g. 409 certification already exists) → same status to the client.
No replica owns the airport → 404. The owner is down → 503 (reads of MAD keep working from the read models).
